name: Grandma's House: College Days
source:
Dive into Grandma's House: College Days, a cheeky adult kinetic novel offering a light-hearted romp through college life, evoking chuckles more than challenges. As the main character, stumble through a series of amusing, mildly risqué escapades amidst a backdrop of casual college camaraderie. With a sprinkle of humor and a dash of romance, this game serves as a whimsical prelude to the Grandma's House saga, setting a playful stage for the escapades that follow. It's a small slice of light-hearted fun, nothing more, nothing less—perfect for a casual, comedic diversion from the daily grind.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640100/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《深入奶奶家：大学时光》是一本厚颜无耻的成人动态小说，讲述了大学生活中轻松愉快的故事，带来的笑声多于挑战。作为主角，在轻松的大学友情背景下，跌跌撞撞地经历了一系列有趣、略带下流的越轨行为。这款游戏充满幽默感和浪漫气息，为奶奶之家的传奇故事拉开了异想天开的序幕，为接下来的冒险活动搭建了一个有趣的舞台。这是一小段轻松的乐趣，仅此而已，非常适合从日常琐事中休闲、喜剧地消遣。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640100/]Steam[/url]]
